business_summary.text: Borosil Scientific is a leading Indian manufacturer of laboratory glassware, scientific instruments, and pharmaceutical primary packaging, recently demerged from Borosil Ltd.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Borosil Scientific is undertaking a glassware capacity expansion from ~15 lakh units p.a. to ~108 lakh units p.a. with an estimated capex of ₹60 Cr, targeting commercial production by March 2027.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Management targets achieving a medium-term revenue CAGR of 12-14%.

Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹114.96 Cr, net profit ₹5.31 Cr.
Borosil Scientific reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹5.3 Cr and announced a ₹130 Cr capex plan for capacity expansion and backward integration.
